title: Hamilton Beach 1.7 Liter Electric Tea Kettle, Water Boiler & Heater | Fast Boiling 1500 Watts | BPA Free | Cordless Serving | Auto-Shutoff & Boil-Dry Protection | LED Indicator | Iridescent Glass

reviews.title: Happy New Apartment!
reviews.body: Purchased for my tea-drinking daughter when she moved into her new apartment.  She loves it!  It's so pretty with the pearlized glass.  (I bought one for myself after seeing hers and hearing how much she uses it!)
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 8, 2026
reviews.author: JF

reviews.title: A solid, all-around electric kettle
reviews.body: I bought this for my mom, who just needed a way to make a quick cup of Lipton without having to put a pot on the stove (and she doesn’t have a microwave). This fits the bill perfectly! It doesn’t take up much space, it boils water (no remperature controls - just boils) quickly, and the auto shut off feature is great. I also like the blue lights in it that glow while the kettle is working and shut off when it stops. A good visual indicator, and it also looks really cool - try making tea in a dark kitchen and you’ll see what I mean!This kettle also was very reasonably priced, and the iridescent glass makes it look a bit fancier than a “plain” glass kettle. All in all, a great purchase!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on March 11, 2024
reviews.author: Melissa B.

reviews.title: Yeah, it has design flaws, but it's SO SHINY!! 🤩
reviews.body: I am obsessed with the irridescent glass look, and I was thrilled when I found this. I noticed it had a lot of bad reviews so I almost didn't, but I am glad I did!!Yes, it does wobble on the base, which is weird. Why the company didn't address this in manufacturing is beyond me, but it doesn't really affect the functionality.I also don't like the plastic on the lid, and it is a bit tricky to open and pour from because sometimes it burns your hand.But I look at the beauty of it and it makes it all worth it. Also it heats up fast! If Hamilton Beach would fix it up a bit, address there issues and make a new model with a colored silicone handle that is more comfortable a d easier to pour from id be first in line to buy again!
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 9, 2024
reviews.author: Kristen Lucas

reviews.body: Looks nice but is not good quality. Opening lid is difficult-have to pinch two things to get it open and it doesn’t stay open unless you open it all the way. When pouring water it spills if tilted to far forward. Not worth the $. Buying a breville

reviews.author: Joan M Skinner

reviews.title: Works well!
reviews.body: It is a little wobbly, but it works well and heats up my water for a few cups of tea in about 5 minutes. Couldn’t ask for much more.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on October 11, 2024
reviews.author: Doranbe

reviews.title: Ordered new but received someone else's return
reviews.body: Have not used it yet so I hope there's nothing wrong with it, it seems fine. But what I DON'T love is paying for a brand new product and receiving something in a damaged box that's already been taped shut again. The kettle was even shoved back into the styrofoam in the box upside down with the instruction manual crumpled at the bottom, this is very obviously someone's previously returned order. I'd be fine with that had that been stated, but this is listed as a new item. Not cool, Amazon. 2 stars because I like it, it's pretty, and seems to be in fine condition.Update - it's wobbly on the base, I wonder if that's why it was previously returned. It seems to work fine though, and boils water fast.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 31, 2025
reviews.author: Traci

reviews.title: Ineffective Filter
reviews.body: I rarely return things, but I immediately returned this electric kettle without even turning it on.  I did fill it with water and tested the filter that hangs down from the lid.  Much water passes by the large (about 3/16") gap between filter and the glass.  I think many people just remove the filter.  The whole product gave me an impression of low quality, and I did not think I would be happy with it.  It has a lot of positive reviews, but the reviews seem to cover more than one model, which is very confusing.  The one I bought had the Iridescent Clear Glass and white handle and cover.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on January 15, 2024
reviews.author: TCATDI

features: FAST BOIL WITH 1500 WATTS — This glass electric kettle boils up to 1.7 liters of water faster than a microwave and safer than a stovetop kettle. Make a quick, hot cup of tea or French press coffee anytime without a long wait — perfect for hectic mornings.
AUTO SHUTOFF FOR PEACE OF MIND. The Hamilton Beach electric kettle automatically turns off when it reaches a boil. Boil-dry protection keeps the kettle from scorching if water gets low.

BPA-FREE, BOROSILICATE GLASS INTERIOR: Whether you're boiling water for hot beverages or making a quick batch of instant noodles, the interior is made of BPA-free borosilicate glass walls and stainless steel heating plate for confident, worry-free use.

LOOKS GREAT IN THE KITCHEN: This electric kettle looks great on the kitchen countertop. The glass has a beautiful iridescent quality, and blue LED lights illuminate when water is heating for a soft blue glow.
CONVENIENT CORD-FREE SERVING. The cordless electric kettle lifts off the base to serve hot water at the tabletop or anywhere you're serving hot beverages or need boiling water.
